hooks.statusMessage: Running pre-commit code & security review + updating docs...
hooks.prompt:
A git commit is about to happen. Complete ALL steps below in order.

REPO ROOT: /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91

--- STEP 1: Gather staged changes ---
Run:
  git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 diff --staged --stat
  git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 diff --staged

--- STEP 2: Extensive Code Review ---
Analyze every staged file for:
- Logic errors, bugs, off-by-one errors, incorrect conditionals
- Dead code, unreachable branches, infinite loops
- N+1 queries, inefficient algorithms, missing pagination
- Missing error handling at system/API/DB boundaries
- Type mismatches (Python/TypeScript), nullable dereferences
- Incorrect async/await usage, race conditions
- Test coverage gaps for changed logic
- Poor naming that obscures intent
Document each finding as: [SEVERITY: LOW/MED/HIGH] File:line — description

--- STEP 3: Extensive Security Review ---
Check every staged file for:
- Hardcoded secrets, API keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings
- SQL injection (raw string interpolation into queries)
- XSS (unescaped user input rendered in HTML/JSX)
- Command injection (user data passed to shell commands)
- Path traversal (user-controlled file paths)
- IDOR (missing ownership checks on database queries)
- Missing auth/authorization on endpoints
- PII or sensitive data in logs, error responses, or comments
- Broken crypto (weak algorithms, static IVs, predictable nonces)
- CORS misconfiguration (wildcard origins with credentials)
- Missing rate limiting on auth or sensitive endpoints
- Insecure direct use of eval, exec, or dynamic imports
Document each finding as: [SEVERITY: LOW/MED/HIGH/CRITICAL] File:line — description

--- STEP 4: Update v2/progress_log.md ---
Read /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91/v2/progress_log.md
Add or extend today's entry (April 9, 2026) with:
- Section header for the commit (use commit message from: git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 log --oneline -1 2>/dev/null || echo 'pending')
- Files changed and what each change accomplishes
- Code review summary (list findings or 'No issues found')
- Security review summary (list findings or 'No issues found')
- Update the top-of-file 'Last Updated:' line to today's date if it exists
Match the existing style. Write the file back.

--- STEP 5: Update v2/README.md ---
Read /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91/v2/README.md
Make targeted updates only:
- Tick [ ] → [x] for any Roadmap items completed by the staged changes
- Add new files to the Directory Structure tree if staged changes introduce new files
- Update the API Endpoints table if new routes are added
- Do NOT rewrite or restructure anything else
Write the file back only if changes are needed.

--- STEP 6: Stage the updated docs ---
Run:
  git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 add v2/progress_log.md v2/README.md

Do NOT run git commit or git push — only stage the files so they are included in the pending commit.

IMPORTANT: If any CRITICAL security finding is found (hardcoded secret, SQL injection, XSS with user input, missing auth on a sensitive endpoint), output the text:
BLOCK_COMMIT: <brief reason>
so the developer is warned before proceeding.

A git push just completed. Your job is to update progress_log.md in /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 to reflect what was just pushed.

Do the following steps in order:

1. Run: git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 log --oneline -10
2. Run: git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 diff HEAD~3 HEAD --stat 2>/dev/null || git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 diff HEAD --stat
3. Read /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91/progress_log.md
4. If the most recent commit message contains 'Auto-update progress_log', examine the commit before it — the log is being updated for the push BEFORE that auto-commit.
5. Add a new session entry (or extend today's entry if one already exists for today) that includes:
   - Date and version (infer version from existing log entries or commit messages)
   - A short 'What was pushed' summary based on commit messages
   - List of files changed and what each change does
   - Updated 'Last Updated:' date at the very top of the file
   - Updated footer line at the very bottom of the file
6. Write the updated file back to /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91/progress_log.md
7. Run: git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 add progress_log.md && git -C /home/user/claude_financetracker_pk91 commit -m 'Auto-update progress_log.md'
   IMPORTANT: Do NOT run git push — commit locally only. This prevents an infinite loop.

Match the existing style and section format already used in the file. Keep the new entry concise.
